2. Tier-label the structural line: `status=…` -> `validate status=… errors=… warnings=…` (spec.check.ex ~:106, spec.validate.ex ~:88). Rename in place, NOT keep-and-add — compatibility inventory in the refined plan proved the only stdout parser is this repo's own test file.

4. ERROR-last display ordering in print_branch_report and print_validation_findings (display-only sort; report map and record_evidence untouched).
5. Read-protocol sentence appended where prime/next suggest spec.check: prime.ex default_loop/2 BOTH clauses (~:64,:73, in the step string below hashed format_human/1); next.ex format_human/2 suggested_commands rendering (~:55-56, not realization-hashed). - Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: compile-graph-scoped checks only (mix test --stale or named files) plus mix spec.check --no-run-commands; no full suite mid-iteration.
  - Final tier: immediately before IMPLEMENTED, full merge-gate list run-until-green: mix compile --warnings-as-errors && mix test && mix format --check-formatted && mix deps.unlock --check-unused && mix spec.check (bare). Judge spec.check by exit status + zero ERROR branch findings, not the status line.
  - Verifier tier: flipped stubs and targeted/--stale selections only; no full suite.

Gap 3 reproduces: sort_findings_for_display/1 is wired into spec.check.ex:222 and spec.validate.ex:107, but the only ordering assertion is branch-side (spec_check_test.exs:84-90); both validate-fail fixtures are severity-homogeneous (spec_tasks_test.exs:181 errors=0 warnings=1; :601 error_findings=0), so deleting the validation-side sort call leaves every test green.

The four out-of-Allowed spec files are attestation prose only — I read all four diffs and each adds a "Branch reconciliation note" paragraph above the spec-verification block with no requirement or claim-wording change, matching the verifier's characterization. Intent-level Out of Scope holds: every Mix.raise is retained with the verdict printed immediately before it, print_verdict is a private helper duplicated in both task modules with no new lib/ file, the sort result is only ever piped into Enum.each (record_evidence/3 at spec.check.ex:135 receives the unsorted report and runs before print_verdict("pass") at :136), the status line is renamed in place with no bare "status=" survivor, and mix.exs/mix.lock are absent from the diff.

Seam trace — NOT an integration regression. The disclosed seam (drain_shell_messages/1, test_support/specled_ex_case.ex:122, matching {:mix_shell, _level, payload} at all levels) does not hide a disconnected production path. The tests drive the real entry points: Mix.Tasks.Spec.Check.run/1 at spec_check_test.exs:223 and Mix.Tasks.Spec.Validate.run/1 at spec_tasks_test.exs:171/:192/:265/:291, with only the shell adapter substituted globally (test/test_helper.exs:11 sets Mix.Shell.Process). Channel fidelity is separately proven against real stdout by the verifier's own execution (mix spec.validate --output <tmp> 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^spec\.validate' = 2), which is also what established Gap 1. So the verdict contract is exercised on the production call path, and the audit adds no INTEGRATION_REGRESSION_LATENT finding.

Two corrections to the verifier's advisory Notes, neither changing the routing (the FAIL verdict and all four gaps stand as written):
1. The stdout/stderr Note states the residual risk backwards. "A future stderr emission placed after the verdict would pass these tests" is wrong — because drain_shell_messages/1 captures :error messages too, such an emission would become List.last(messages) and BREAK all seven assertions. The real residual hole is the opposite and narrower: the mailbox is channel-blind, so a verdict emitted via Mix.shell().error instead of .info would satisfy spec_tasks_test.exs:182, :272, :429, :601, :629, :766 and spec_check_test.exs:92 while violating the requirement's "on stdout" clause. Worth stating correctly in whatever the implementer writes for Gap 2, since the fix touches these same assertions.
2. Gap 2's "No test covers them" is loose. test/mix/tasks/spec_tasks_test.exs:190-194 already drives the argument-validation raise path (Mix.Tasks.Spec.Validate.run(["--root", root, "--strcit"]) inside assert_raise Mix.Error). Bounce reason: Address all four items the verifier named. (a) Resolve the Gap 1 contradiction between specled.tasks.verdict_line and spec.validate.ex:82 — either rename that auxiliary print to a non-task-name prefix and update spec_tasks_test.exs:180, or narrow the requirement wording; if you narrow it, the read-protocol sentence duplicated in prime.ex, next.ex, spec_prime_task_test.exs:23 and spec_next_task_test.exs:24 teaches a grep anchor that must still hold, so say explicitly which anchor survives. (c) Add a validation-tier fixture with mixed error and warning severities so the error-last sort at spec.check.ex:222 and spec.validate.ex:107 is falsifiable; today deleting either call is invisible. (d) The test/mix/tasks/spec_check_test.exs expansion and the evidence_store.spec.md attestation it forced were a silent scope expansion — the engineering reason is legitimate, so get the ticket's Allowed list amended to cover both before re-submitting rather than expanding again in place. The branch_guard/status/verification attestations are a ticket-authoring gap, not implementer overreach, and should be added to the Allowed carve-out at the same time.
